info.name: ShopBuilder API
info.description:
## ShopBuilder — Enterprise Multi-Tenant E-Commerce API

**Version:** 2.0.0
**Base URL:** {{baseUrl}} (default: http://localhost:3000)
**Docs:** http://localhost:3000/docs

---

### Quick Start

1. Import this collection and the **ShopBuilder — Local** environment
2. Select **ShopBuilder — Local** as the active environment
3. Run **🔄 End-to-End Flows → Flow 1** to bootstrap the platform
4. Then run **Flow 2** for the customer shopping flow

---

### Authentication

All endpoints (except Health, Register, Login, Forgot/Reset Password, Verify Email) require a Bearer token.

The **Login** requests automatically save `accessToken` and `refreshToken` to the environment.

Token lifetimes:
- Access token: **15 minutes**
- Refresh token: **7 days** (revocable)

---

### Roles

| Role | Description |
|---|---|
| SUPER_ADMIN | Full platform access |
| PLATFORM_ADMIN | Manages merchants and platform config |
| MERCHANT_OWNER | Manages own stores, products, orders |
| STORE_MANAGER | Manages inventory and orders |
| CUSTOMER | Places and views own orders |

item.name: 🏥 Health
item.description: Public health check endpoint — no auth required.

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description:
JWT authentication — access token (15 min) + revocable refresh token (7 days).

• Register → sends verification email
• Login → run this to auto-populate accessToken and refreshToken in the environment
• Tokens are automatically saved after Login and Refresh

item.name: Register
item.description: Creates a new CUSTOMER account. A verification email is queued. Rate limited: 10 req/min.

item.name: Register — as MERCHANT_OWNER
item.description: Creates a MERCHANT_OWNER account.

item.name: Register — as SUPER_ADMIN
item.description: Creates a SUPER_ADMIN account (only safe in dev environments).

item.name: Verify Email
item.description: Validates the token from the verification email. Paste the token from the email into the emailVerificationToken env var.

item.name: Login
item.description: Authenticates and returns accessToken + refreshToken. Both are auto-saved to the environment.

item.name: Login — as SUPER_ADMIN
item.description: Login as SUPER_ADMIN. Tokens auto-saved. Use this before admin operations.

item.name: Login — as MERCHANT_OWNER
item.description: Login as MERCHANT_OWNER. Tokens auto-saved.

item.name: Refresh Access Token
item.description: Exchange refresh token for a new access token. New accessToken is auto-saved.

item.name: Logout
item.description: Revokes the refresh token. The access token remains valid until its 15-min expiry.

item.name: Get Current User
item.description: Returns the JWT payload of the authenticated user.

item.name: Forgot Password
item.description: Queues a password reset email. Always returns 200 to prevent email enumeration. Rate limited: 5 req/15 min.

item.name: Reset Password
item.description: Sets a new password using the token from the reset email. All sessions are revoked.

item.name: Change Password
item.description: Changes password and revokes all active sessions. Requires current password.

item.name: 🛒 Cart
item.description:
Shopping cart and checkout flow.

Cart is per-user per-store. A cart is automatically created on first addItem.
POST /cart/checkout converts the cart into a PENDING order atomically.

item.name: Get Cart
item.description: Returns the current cart for the authenticated user for a given store.

item.name: Add Item to Cart
item.description: Adds an item to the cart. If the variant is already in the cart, quantity is incremented. Validates available stock.

item.name: Update Item Quantity
item.description: Sets the quantity for a specific variant in the cart.

item.name: Remove Item from Cart
item.description: Removes a single item from the cart.

item.name: Clear Cart
item.description: Removes all items from the cart.

item.name: Checkout (Cart → Order)
item.description:
Atomically:
1. Validates stock for all items
2. Creates a PENDING order
3. Reserves stock for each item
4. Clears the cart
5. Queues an order confirmation email

item.name: 📦 Products
item.description:
Product catalog and SKU/variant management.

The variant system uses a Cartesian product engine:
  sizes × colors × materials → all SKU combinations

Use /products/generate-variants to preview, then /products/save-variants to persist.

item.name: List Products
item.description: Paginated list scoped to tenantId from JWT. Admins can filter across tenants.

item.name: Create Product
item.description: Requires MERCHANT_OWNER, PLATFORM_ADMIN, or SUPER_ADMIN.

item.name: Delete Product
item.description: Hard delete. Variants are cascade-deleted.

item.name: Preview SKU Matrix (not saved)
item.description: Generates the Cartesian product of all attributes. 4 sizes × 3 colors × 1 material = 12 SKUs. Nothing is saved to the database.

item.name: Save Variants (persist SKU matrix)
item.description: Generates and persists all SKU combinations for a product. Idempotent — safe to re-run.

item.name: Update Stock Delta (legacy)
item.description: Adjusts stock by a delta (positive = add, negative = subtract). Prefer /inventory endpoints for granular control.

item.name: 📊 Inventory
item.description:
Transaction-safe stock management.

Stock model:
  stock          = physical units on hand
  reservedStock  = held for PENDING orders
  availableStock = stock − reservedStock  (computed)

Flow:
  CREATE ORDER  → reserveStock
  ORDER PAID    → stock−=qty, reserved−=qty  (automatic)
  ORDER CANCEL  → releaseStock               (automatic)

item.name: Get Inventory Status
item.description: Returns stock, reservedStock, and computed availableStock.

item.name: Increase Stock (goods received)
item.description: Increments physical stock. Use when receiving new stock.

item.name: Decrease Stock (write-off)
item.description: Decrements physical stock. Use for shrinkage or damaged goods.

item.name: Reserve Stock (for order)
item.description: Increments reservedStock. Only succeeds if availableStock >= quantity.

item.name: Release Stock (order cancelled)
item.description: Decrements reservedStock. Only succeeds if reserved >= quantity.

item.name: Transfer Stock Between Variants
item.description: Atomically moves stock from one variant to another. Source and destination must differ.

item.name: 📋 Orders
item.description:
Order lifecycle management.

State machine:
  PENDING → PAID (deducts stock), CANCELLED (releases reserve)
  PAID    → PACKED, REFUNDED
  PACKED  → SHIPPED
  SHIPPED → DELIVERED
  DELIVERED → REFUNDED
  CANCELLED, REFUNDED → terminal

Customers see only their own orders.
MERCHANT_OWNER / STORE_MANAGER can advance status.

item.name: Create Order (direct)
item.description: Creates a PENDING order and reserves stock atomically. Prefer POST /cart/checkout for the full cart flow.

item.name: List Orders
item.description: CUSTOMER role automatically scoped to their own orders.

item.name: Update Order Status → PAID
item.description: PENDING → PAID: deducts stock permanently (stock−=qty, reserved−=qty).

item.name: Cancel Order
item.description: Cancels a PENDING order and atomically releases reserved stock. Customers can cancel their own orders.

item.name: 🏢 Merchants
item.description:
Merchant entity management. Merchants belong to a Tenant and own Stores.

RBAC:
  Create/Delete: SUPER_ADMIN, PLATFORM_ADMIN
  Read/Update:   MERCHANT_OWNER+
  Suspend/Activate: SUPER_ADMIN, PLATFORM_ADMIN

item.name: Create Merchant
item.description: SUPER_ADMIN and PLATFORM_ADMIN only.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Acme Retail Ltd",
  "email": "contact@acme-retail.com",
  "phone": "+1-555-0100",
  "address": "123 Commerce St, New York, NY 10001",
  "tenantId": "{{tenantId}}"
}

item.name: Suspend Merchant
item.description: Sets merchant status to SUSPENDED.

item.name: Activate Merchant
item.description: Re-activates a SUSPENDED merchant.

item.name: Delete Merchant
item.description: SUPER_ADMIN only. Hard delete.

item.name: 🏪 Stores
item.description:
Store management within a merchant.

Stores belong to a Merchant and scoped to a Tenant.
Products and Orders are associated with a Store.

item.name: Delete Store
item.description: Hard delete. SUPER_ADMIN, PLATFORM_ADMIN, MERCHANT_OWNER.

item.name: 👑 Admin
item.description:
Platform administration — SUPER_ADMIN and PLATFORM_ADMIN only.

Tenant → Merchant → Store hierarchy.
User role management and platform-wide statistics.

item.name: Platform Stats
item.description: Returns total counts for users, tenants, merchants, stores, products, orders — grouped by status/role.

item.name: Update User Role
item.description: SUPER_ADMIN only. Changes role and optionally assigns/removes tenant.

item.name: Delete User
item.description: SUPER_ADMIN only. Hard delete.

item.name: Create Tenant
item.description: Creates an isolated tenant namespace.

item.name: 🔄 End-to-End Flows
item.description:
Complete business scenario walkthroughs.

Run in order:
  Flow 1 → Platform Setup (SUPER_ADMIN)
  Flow 2 → Customer Shopping
  Flow 3 → Order Fulfillment (Merchant)

All flows auto-save environment variables as they progress.

item.name: ⚡ [Flow 1] Platform Setup (SUPER_ADMIN)
item.description:
Run these requests top-to-bottom to bootstrap the platform.

Each step auto-saves IDs into environment variables.
Login as SUPER_ADMIN first (run "Login — as SUPER_ADMIN" from the Auth folder).

item.name: ⚡ [Flow 2] Customer Shopping (register → checkout)
item.description:
Customer end-to-end flow.

Run Flow 1 first to set up tenantId, storeId, and variantId.
These requests simulate a real customer session.

exec: console.log('[Flow 2] Registered. Check email for verification token.');

item.name: [2/2] Login as Customer
item.description: If REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=true, verify email first using the token from the inbox.

item.name: [2/8] Cancel Order
item.description: Customer can cancel their own PENDING orders. Stock is released.

item.name: ⚡ [Flow 3] Order Fulfillment (merchant view)
item.description:
Merchant processes a customer order through all states.

Run Flow 1 and Flow 2 first. Order must exist in PENDING status.
Login as MERCHANT_OWNER before running these steps.

exec: console.log('[Flow 3] Order marked PAID — stock deducted');
